answer: Staked Endorsement Trust 1) Users deposit a small stake, say 100 coins, to join and endorse others. 2) Endorsements from staked users are weighted by their stake. 3) Malicious actors attempting sybil attacks must stake for each identity, increasing their cost. The cost for N identities is $100 x N$. The horizon of trust is 5 degrees. The mechanism fails if a powerful cartel with a large combined stake colludes to falsely endorse sybil accounts, creating a false dune of reputation. This is like a single, dominant violet hue poisoning a garden of diverse colors.
